entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-22
entry.content:
Issues

  • dotnet dev-certs https doesn't support sub domains #52272
  • Interactive TFM selection doesn't evaluate TargetFrameworks extracted from file-based apps #52271
  • Pop_OS! 24.04 libicu is not installable #52269

Closed

  • "csc.exe" exited with code -1073741819. #52262

Created

Merged

    Servicing-approved, Area-run-file, 10.0.3

    DO NOT MERGE, PublishVsBuild, Area-NativeAOT, Area-Trimming

    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
